name: aidd-packs
description: An optional part of aidd-team: a domain pack per domain, each a skill with the domain's standards, a checklist per loop step, and test commands for a Spec, such as web, APIs, mobile, desktop, AI features, AI agents, data, cloud, payments, health, embedded, public sector, children, and internationalization. A role loads a pack by name, when aidd risk, the config, or the lead names it, so no model has to find a pack from its description. Needs the aidd-team plugin. Install it in a project that calls for a pack: its descriptions share Claude Code's skill listing budget with every other skill.
